name: Cell
intent: Content for one table cell: text, a link, a person, a file, a status, a trend, progress, a rating, a select, row actions or a row menu, a tree row, with an optional row checkbox. Each cell is full width with a faint bottom border.
usage: Use Cell inside table cells to show one kind of value consistently. Pick the type from the data: text for plain values, link to open a record, avatar for a person, badge for status, trend for change, progress for how far along something is, actions for row buttons, actionMenu for a More menu, select to change a value in place, checkbox for a column with only the row Checkbox, tree for the first cell of parent and child rows (an indent per level, faint guide lines and a chevron to open and close its children). Cell composes kit Avatar, AvatarGroup, Badge, Button, ButtonGroup, Checkbox, DropdownMenu, Icon, Progress and Select; it never draws its own. Pair with HeaderCell for column titles. See contracts/cell.json for the full contract.

size.note: Row height 48 / 56 px. Side padding 12 px at both sizes, same as HeaderCell. Avatars, Badge and Checkbox stay sm (32 / 20 / 16 px) so rows keep their height. Without a size, a surrounding Density in compact makes it sm.

align.note: Same as HeaderCell: end for numbers and amounts, center for a checkbox-only column.

text.note: Show the text next to the visual. Off = visual only; the text stays for screen readers where needed. For progress it is the percent after the bar.

checkbox.note: Leading row Checkbox before the value, labeled Select {label or name}. For a column with only the Checkbox, use type checkbox.

label.note: The text. For link it is the link text. For avatar it is the second line when name is set. For actionMenu it names the More button (default Row actions). For select it is the hidden field name. For progress it names the bar for screen readers (default Progress). For checkbox it names the row: the Checkbox is Select {label}.

href.note: For link. Where the link goes. Links navigate only; use actions for operations.

onClick.note: For link. Without href the link is a button that acts in place, like picking a row in a Lookup; with href it runs before the link opens.

icon.note: Material Symbols name. file defaults to description, payment to credit_card. For tree, an optional icon before the label.

value.note: Trend amount like 12%, progress 0 to 100, rating 0 to 5, or the picked option for select.

actions.note: For actions (labeled, up to 3), actionIcons (icon only, up to 3, label becomes the name and a kit Tooltip) and actionMenu (menu items, danger variant becomes a danger item). onClick runs when picked.

options.note: For select. The value prop is the picked option.

level.note: For tree. The row's depth: 1 for top rows, 2 for their children, and so on. Each level steps in 32 px (tree/indent).

expanded.note: For tree. Set it (true or false) on rows that have children to show the chevron; leave it out on rows without children, which line up with their parent's label.

onExpandedChange.note: For tree. The chevron was clicked; show or hide the row's children. The table keeps which rows are open.

showLines.note: For tree. Faint lines under each open parent's chevron, joining its children from row to row.

useWhen: A row that mixes text, people, status and actions.
doNot: Do not invent a local table cell, Tag, Trend, FileIcon, PaymentMethod, Rating or ActionCell.
Do not draw a progress bar in a cell. Use type progress; it is a kit Progress.
Do not use Badge for trends. Use a trend type.
Do not use link for actions like Delete or Send. Use actions or actionIcons.
Do not draw a local Avatar, Badge, Checkbox or Button. Cell composes the kit ones.
Use actionMenu instead of actionIcons when a row has more than 3 actions or a destructive one.
Do not put more than 3 badges or 3 actions in one cell.
Do not fake a progress cell before the kit Progress exists.
a11y: link renders a real <a href> with a visible focus ring; the label is the link name.
Visual icons (file, payment, trend arrows, stars) are decorative; the text carries the meaning.
When text is off, file, payment and trend cells get an aria-label from label or value.
rating is role=img, read as {n} of 5.
The row checkbox has a hidden label: Select {label or name}.
Icon-only actions keep their label as the button name.
actionMenu is a kit DropdownMenu: an icon-only More button named by label, opening a role=menu.
select is a small kit Select with a hidden label from label, named with its value.
progress is a kit Progress: a progressbar named by label, read as its percent.
tree: the chevron is a kit Button named Expand or Collapse and the row label, with aria-expanded. The indent and guide lines are hidden from screen readers.

examples.title: Text
examples.usage: Plain value. Add checkbox for a selectable row.

examples.title: Link
examples.usage: A record name or ID that opens its page. Navigation only.

examples.title: Avatar
examples.usage: A person with the kit Avatar. label adds a second line, like an email.

examples.title: Avatar group
examples.usage: Several people, like the owners of an account. Shows 3, then +N.

examples.title: File and payment
examples.usage: A decorative icon before the value. The text carries the meaning.

examples.title: Badge
examples.usage: One status. Use badges for up to three labels.

examples.title: Trend
examples.usage: Change against the last period. Green arrow up, red arrow down. Never a Badge.

examples.title: Progress
examples.usage: How far along a row is, from 0 to 100: a kit Progress bar that fills the cell, with the percent after it. label names it for screen readers.

examples.title: Rating
examples.usage: A score from 0 to 5, read as {n} of 5.

examples.title: Select
examples.usage: Change a value in place, like a status. A small kit Select that fills the cell.

examples.title: Actions
examples.usage: Row buttons. Labeled actions sit in a ButtonGroup; icon actions keep their label as the hidden name. Up to 3.

examples.title: Action menu
examples.usage: A More button that opens a DropdownMenu, aligned to the row end. The danger action goes last.

examples.title: Checkbox only
examples.usage: type checkbox is a select column: just the row Checkbox, named Select plus the row's label.

examples.title: Tree
examples.usage: Parent and child accounts in a Table: the chevron opens and closes a row's children; rows without children line up with their parent's label.
